name: HIGH-VIX armed contrarian long — RSI-oversold snap (BTC/ETH/SOL)
rationale: Thesis: panic mean-reversion only pays when the WHOLE risk complex is stressed. Arm the trade with equity VIX elevated (gt vix_floor, a BOUNDED regime level), then require the crypto majors' own RSI to be oversold (lt rsi_floor) — a forced-seller flush inside a macro-fear window snaps back harder than a routine dip. Exit when RSI normalizes up through rsi_exit, or risk/time stops. Low turnover: both conditions extreme at once is rare. Disconfirmer 1 (is the VIX arm load-bearing?): the same RSI-oversold long with NO VIX gate is in the cohort — if the ungated version matches or beats the deflated Sharpe, the regime arm adds nothing and this is plain dip-buying. Disconfirmer 2 (trade count): two simultaneous extremes is rare; too few trades is an honest insufficient-evidence FAIL, not an edge. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must stay positive or it is cycle-position-in-disguise.
catalyst: VIX elevated AND majors RSI oversold simultaneously
